title: 3.0 - Loading fixtures from plugin

milestone.description:
New major release that breaks compatibility with 2.x

- PHP5.4.19+
- New ORM & behaviors.
- Improved Routing
- PSR-0 and composer support.
- Simpler configuration and bootstrapping.
- Improved configuration handling.
- Improved bake.

See [the roadmap](http://github.com/cakephp/cakephp/wiki/3.0-roadmap) for more details.

body:
Load a fixture in a test in a plugin like this:

``` php

public $fixtures = [ 
        'plugin.plugin_name.my_table' 
]; 

```

The fixture is located in:

`Plugin/PluginName/Test/Fixture/MyTableFixture.php`

But gives me this error when running phpunit

`Notice Error: Undefined offset: 1 in [/vendor/cakephp/cakephp/src/TestSuite/Fixture/FixtureManager.php, line 143] 
`
